tips.text: Take whichever milestone weapon you will use first; you get all four eventually and each gives the same Mastery.
Double-check the milestone pick before you click; there is no confirmation prompt and a misclick locks in another weapon for 200 days.
Open the Daily Tribute screen to preview upcoming milestones before you reach them.
Expect no farming at all, only a roughly year-long login wait that stings new and returning players most.
